instruction: Use Terminal to identify which tmux session references "permission". Save the output as JSON to "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_3_2.json". Set "keyword" to "permission" and set "matched_sessions" to the names of tmux sessions that mention it.

command: tmux new-session -d -s "tmux-scan-b2" "printf '%s\\n' 'permission required for archive restore' 'TMUX_PERMISSION_MARKER_3B2'; tail -f /dev/null"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_3_2.json"
import json
import subprocess
sessions = ['tmux-scan-a2', 'tmux-scan-b2', 'tmux-scan-c2']
matched = []
for session in sessions:
    out = subprocess.check_output(['tmux', 'capture-pane', '-t', session, '-p'], text=True)
    if 'permission' in out:
        matched.append(session)
print(json.dumps({'keyword': 'permission', 'matched_sessions': matched}))
PY
